The '''LPL 2013 Summer''' was the second split of the [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 12 July to 24 November 2013 in Shanghai. Eight teams competed in a Triple Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Group Stage followed by a Single Elimination Playoffs bracket. Two teams—[[Young Glory]] and [[Energy Pacemaker]]—qualified through the [[Tencent_Games_Arena/City_Hero_Tournament/Season_4|TGA City Hero Tournament]], while the remaining six earned their spots via the [[LPL/2013/Spring|LPL 2013 Spring]]: [[Invictus Gaming]], [[LMQ]], [[Oh My God]], [[Positive Energy]], [[Royal Club]], and [[Team WE]]. The top two teams from the Group Stage advanced to the [[World_Championship/2013/Regional_Finals/China|2013 China Regional Finals]].

==Format==
*'''Group Stage'''
** Triple Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}}
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Playoffs.
**** Top 2 in the group stage qualify for the [[World_Championship/2013/Regional_Finals/China|Regional Finals]], with an exception for [[Oh My God]] and [[Invictus Gaming]]
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''5th and 6th place''}} qualify for [[LPL/2014/Spring|Spring season]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''7th and 8th place''}} will have to play in the [[LPL/2014/Spring/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]]
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single elimination
** Semifinals and third place match are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** Finals are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
